results.name: Ruined High-Rise Building
results.description:
Stylized 3D miniature game asset of a semi-destroyed high-rise building, designed for a D&D tabletop set in a post-apocalyptic ghost town. The aesthetic is heavily inspired by the dilapidated, scary atmosphere of games like 7 Days to Die.

Key features:
• Crumbling gray concrete and exposed red brick walls
• Shattered window frames with twisted rusted rebar
• Scorched black soot marks and weathered surfaces
• Color palette: gray, deep red, and black tones
• Optimized for tabletop miniature scale

Perfect for use in tabletop RPG scenes, dioramas, game environments, or as a reference concept for post-apocalyptic urban assets.

Feel free to use this model in your projects — and don't forget to leave a like if you enjoy it! 👍
